name: creations_search
description: Search user creations: `from`, one `items` entry per creation, and `pagination`. Lean by default: set `full=true` for the whole `creations_get` payload per item, which is how a bulk indexer reads a project without one call per file. Use `creations_get` for one id. `reference` required with from=folder/project-root. Defaults: history, page 1.

dateEnd.description: Only creations created on/before this date (ISO 8601).

dateStart.description: Only creations created on/after this date (ISO 8601).

favorites.description: only = hearted, excluded = not hearted. Combines with a folder.

full.description: Return the full `creations_get` payload for every item on the page (URLs + metadata) instead of the lean projection. For bulk indexing, so one page replaces one `creations_get` per item. Costs more tokens: keep it false for conversational use.

includeSubfolders.description: Also list files in subfolders. Default true for from=project-root (a project means the whole project), false for from=folder. Counts in `pagination.total` follow the same scope.

status.description: Review status (OR), built-in or custom. Needs the tags feature; see `tags_list` / `creations_tags`.

items.description: needs_review, in_progress, approved, rejected, or a custom status name from creations_tags.

tags.description: Custom tag names (OR), as listed by `tags_list` / `creations_tags`.
